query: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem) WITH wi.workItemCode AS workItemCode,count(DISTINCT t) AS tdocCount WITH collect({workItemCode:workItemCode,tdocCount:tdocCount}) AS groups WITH groups,reduce(maxCount=0,g IN groups|CASE WHEN g.tdocCount>maxCount THEN g.tdocCount ELSE maxCount END) AS maxCount UNWIND groups AS g WITH g,maxCount WHERE g.tdocCount=maxCount RETURN g.workItemCode AS workItemCode,g.tdocCount AS tdocCount
